snippet.title: Gentoo Rescue - 1.2 Update trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
A puzzler about sliding penguins and walruses. Pick up items to push, pull, bounce, swap, stop, steal, or explode. Uncover surprising twists hidden in a world of puzzles inside puzzles inside puzzles.

The 1.2 Update of Gentoo Rescue by @jagriff333  adds brand new levels and more to this mind-bending sokoban!

Gentoo Rescue in the Thinky Games DB: https://thinkygames.com/games/gentoo-rescue/
Gentoo Rescue on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2830480/Gentoo_Rescue/
Gentoo Rescue on Itch: https://jagriff.itch.io/gentoo-rescue

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkygames.com/events/direct/2026/
